snippet.title: Pierrot - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Here's your look at the Pierrot announcement trailer for this upcoming first-person psychological horror game set in a twisted theater where a small puppet is trapped in its grasp. Violence is routine and you exist only to obey. Forced to harm others Pierrot dreams of tearing his strings. Even as the curtain falls his role never ends. Pierrot will be available on PC.
